name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Season Two - Echoes of Skyrim
summary:
Venture into Skyrim’s dark heart with both Greymoor and Markarth becoming free with ESO's base game. Explore two classic zones, uncover a realm besieged by dark forces, and unearth the Antiquities system.

Survive Hircine’s trials anew with solo versions of the Moon Hunter Keep and March of Sacrifices dungeons, both redesigned and rebalanced for those who stand strongest alone.
